name: MeshCore-Self-Hosted
description: Self-hosted MeshCore web application with automatic updates. Hosts the official MeshCore web client locally, allowing you to connect to your MeshCore companion radio via USB or Bluetooth. Automatically checks for and downloads new MeshCore releases daily. USB connections work over HTTP with no extra setup. Bluetooth requires HTTPS — use a reverse proxy such as Cloudflare Tunnel or Nginx Proxy Manager in front of this container. Note: your MeshCore device must be flashed with BLE companion firmware to use Bluetooth.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for cached downloads and version tracking.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port to access the MeshCore web interface

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone for container logs e.g. America/Chicago, America/New_York, Europe/London

variables.name: Update Interval
variables.description: How often to check for MeshCore updates in seconds. Default is 86400 (24 hours).

variables.name: Pin Version
variables.description: Pin to a specific MeshCore version e.g. v1.43.0. Leave blank to always use the latest version. When set, auto-updates are disabled.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for MeshCore releases. Do not change unless you know what you are doing.
